nd7dd69052c.headline: Shopify:  Q3 Earnings Snapshot
nd7dd69052c.summary: Shopify reported third-quarter profit of $718 million, or 55 cents per share. The Ottawa-based e-commerce software company published its quarterly results on Thursday.
nd7dd69052c.why: Shopify is a Canadian e-commerce platform whose quarterly results are watched as a read on online retail spending and merchant software demand.

impacts.name: Shopify
impacts.why: The quarterly earnings results are the company's own reported figures.

nb6ae99ab79.headline: Cocoa Surge: ‘Time To Negotiate Better Deals For Farmers
nb6ae99ab79.summary: Commentary says global cocoa prices are spiking due to dwindling supply and calls for Ghana and Côte d'Ivoire to coordinate with regional countries. The aim is better terms for farmers.
nb6ae99ab79.why: Ghana and Côte d'Ivoire together supply a large share of the world's cocoa, so their pricing and policy shape global chocolate input costs.

nb98227b204.headline: Hurricane Otis: Mexico To Give Interest Subsidies But No Loans To Rebuild 377 Acapulco Hotels
nb98227b204.summary: President Andrés Manuel López Obrador said a $3.4 billion package will help rebuild 377 Acapulco hotels after Hurricane Otis. The support will come as interest subsidies rather than loans.
nb98227b204.why: Hotel and tourism operators are sensitive to public support packages, and reconstruction spending affects regional construction and lending.

n4de7e79d14.headline: Sainsbury's sees 2023 profit at upper half of guidance
n4de7e79d14.summary: Sainsbury's forecast full-year profit in the upper half of previous guidance. It reported slightly better-than-expected flat first-half profit, helped by demand for its food ranges.
n4de7e79d14.why: J Sainsbury is one of the UK's largest supermarket groups, and its guidance reflects consumer spending and grocery pricing in Britain.

n754ab7e130.headline: Stock market today: Asian shares surge on hopes the Federal Reserve’s rate hikes are done
n754ab7e130.summary: Asian shares surged after the US Federal Reserve indicated it may not need to tighten policy any further. The move followed signals about the economy from Washington.
n754ab7e130.why: Federal Reserve policy sets global interest rates and the dollar, so signals about rate hikes move equity markets across Asia and beyond.
n754ab7e130.why_moved: The US Federal Reserve indicated it may not need to raise rates any harder, easing concerns about tighter monetary policy and supporting share prices.

ndb71694539.headline: Uganda agrees petroleum importation deal with Bahrain firm
ndb71694539.summary: Uganda National Oil Company has a deal in place with Vitol to supply oil products. Under the arrangement, UNOC will sell the products on to petrol station operators.
ndb71694539.why: Vitol is one of the world's largest independent oil traders, so its supply deals affect fuel availability and pricing in importing countries.

n8e4c7af3e6.headline: Jeffs’ Brands Announces Expected Implementation of 1-for-7 Reverse Share Split
n8e4c7af3e6.summary: Following the reverse share split, Jeffs' Brands will have approximately 1,188,805 ordinary shares outstanding, of which about 52.5% are held by insiders. The announcement was made in Tel Aviv.
n8e4c7af3e6.why: A reverse share split consolidates existing shares into fewer, higher-priced shares, often used by small-cap companies to meet exchange listing price requirements.

n2ff1df36d1.headline: Norway keeps interest rates on hold, eyes December hike
n2ff1df36d1.summary: Norway's central bank kept its benchmark rate unchanged at 4.25%, as widely expected, and said it would likely raise borrowing costs next month unless inflation kept falling.
n2ff1df36d1.why: Norges Bank sets Norway's policy interest rate, which drives borrowing costs across the economy and the krone's yield appeal.

n1195aab4bd.headline: Euro zone factory downturn deepened in October - PMI
n1195aab4bd.summary: Euro zone manufacturing activity contracted further in October in a broad-based downturn, with new orders falling at one of the steepest rates since the survey began in 1997.
n1195aab4bd.why: The manufacturing PMI is a closely watched gauge of factory activity, and weakness in it shapes expectations for euro area growth and central bank policy.

n67c1ee1bc9.headline: BRICS Summit hosting costs huge, but benefit ours: South Africa
n67c1ee1bc9.summary: The government said the cost of hosting the 15th BRICS Summit was fully justified because it brought the country great economic benefits. The statement was issued by the government.
n67c1ee1bc9.why: BRICS is a bloc of major emerging economies, and summit-driven trade and investment links can affect South African business activity.

n908e1a81c0.headline: Cummins :  Q3 2023 Earnings Presentation
n908e1a81c0.summary: Cummins released its third-quarter 2023 earnings presentation covering the quarter's summary, 2023 guidance and supplemental information. The teleconference was held on November 2, 2023.
n908e1a81c0.why: Cummins is a US engine and power systems maker, and its quarterly results and guidance are closely watched as an indicator of industrial and truck demand.

n2e6cc0ec6f.headline: TSX futures climb on commodity boost, Fed verdict lifts mood
n2e6cc0ec6f.summary: Futures for Canada's main stock index rose on Thursday as higher commodity prices were expected to boost energy and materials stocks. Hopes around the US Federal Reserve also lifted sentiment.
n2e6cc0ec6f.why: The S&P/TSX Composite is heavily weighted toward energy and materials, so commodity price moves directly influence its performance.
n2e6cc0ec6f.why_moved: Futures rose as commodity prices were expected to increase, lifting energy and materials stocks, while hopes about the US Federal Reserve improved market mood.

n69fb9fc8ee.headline: Disney To Complete Takeover Of Hulu With $8.6 Bn Deal
n69fb9fc8ee.summary: The Walt Disney Company announced it will buy Comcast's $8.6 billion stake in Hulu, completing its takeover of the streaming service. The deal was announced on a Wednesday.
n69fb9fc8ee.why: Disney is a major media and entertainment company, and Hulu is a key streaming asset in its direct-to-consumer strategy.

nfab43a6d03.headline: “Nigeria’s 220.7 million mobile subscriptions offer opportunities for fintech growth” - NCC
nfab43a6d03.summary: The Nigerian Communications Commission reported 220.7 million mobile subscriptions in August, highlighting significant fintech growth potential in Nigeria.
nfab43a6d03.why: Mobile penetration is a key driver for fintech adoption in Nigeria, Africa's largest economy, impacting financial inclusion and digital payments.

na461f59487.headline: Is it possible to make housing in Ireland more affordable?
na461f59487.summary: Policy discussions focus on making housing more affordable in Ireland amid rising property prices.
na461f59487.why: Housing affordability impacts consumer spending, construction activity, and overall economic stability in Ireland.

n375899b787.headline: Origin Energy shareholder rejects fresh Brookfield $10.5 bln bid, shares fall
n375899b787.summary: Shareholders of Origin Energy rejected a bid from Brookfield, leading to a decline in the company's shares amid strategic asset considerations.
n375899b787.why: The outcome affects the energy sector and investor confidence in Australian utilities and renewable energy assets.

n01ba19d319.headline: Stock market update: Nifty Auto index  advances  0.71%
n01ba19d319.summary: The Nifty Auto index closed 0.71% higher, reflecting positive investor sentiment in India's auto sector.
n01ba19d319.why: Auto sector performance influences broader market sentiment and reflects economic activity in India.

n8b999830c4.headline: A record number of firms are going public in India this year
n8b999830c4.summary: India has seen 184 firms go public in 2023, with October alone listing 30 companies, the highest in recent years.
n8b999830c4.why: A surge in IPO activity can signal increased investor confidence and economic growth prospects in India.

n8abafaa810.headline: Japan unveils $113B stimulus to cushion economic blow from inflation
n8abafaa810.summary: Japan announced a $113 billion stimulus package to mitigate economic impacts from inflation, aiming to support growth and consumer spending.
n8abafaa810.why: Japan's stimulus aims to support its economy amid inflationary pressures, influencing monetary policy and financial markets.

n10345a1673.headline: Dow Jumps 565, Nasdaq Gains 233, S&P Climbs 80
n10345a1673.summary: U.S. stocks rose and major indices gained as Fed Chair Powell indicated additional interest rate hikes could be warranted.
n10345a1673.why: Market expectations of rate hikes influence equity valuations and bond yields.
n10345a1673.why_moved: Market optimism on rate hike signals led to gains in equities and bond yields rising.

nb63beef61b.headline: Finance Minister is accountable to Parliament with Fiscal Responsibility Act
nb63beef61b.summary: Malaysia's Finance Minister now reports to Parliament on fiscal targets following the enactment of the Fiscal Responsibility Act.
nb63beef61b.why: This law aims to improve fiscal discipline and transparency, affecting government debt and economic policy.

n6038d64ad3.headline: Australia's 'shonkiest' businesses revealed
n6038d64ad3.summary: Australian businesses identified as problematic, leading to customer dissatisfaction and potential reputational risks.
n6038d64ad3.why: Business reputation and consumer trust impact market performance and investment climate in Australia.

n091bb55602.headline: Thursday newspaper round-up: Borrowing costs, earnings, Walt Disney
n091bb55602.summary: The Bank of England is widely expected to keep its key base rate at 5.25%, amid concerns over mortgage costs and economic stability.
n091bb55602.why: Interest rate decisions influence borrowing costs, mortgage rates, and overall economic activity in the UK, impacting consumers and financial markets.
n091bb55602.why_moved: Market expectations of the rate hold reflect investor anticipation of monetary policy stability.

nb6d368c006.headline: House speaker pitches funding plan with rolling shutdown threats
nb6d368c006.summary: US House Republicans propose funding plans with potential shutdown deadlines for various agencies.
nb6d368c006.why: Government shutdowns can disrupt economic activity, federal spending, and investor confidence in US markets.

n119a5474cd.headline: Hajj Commission seeks partnership with Umrah operators to tackle pilgrimage challenges
n119a5474cd.summary: Ghana anticipates reaching an agreement with the IMF's Credit Committee soon over its external debt restructuring process.
n119a5474cd.why: An IMF agreement can unlock financial support for Ghana, impacting its economic stability and debt management.

n96923d0d7f.headline: Stocks Rally And Dollar Drop On Hopes Fed Rates Have Peaked
n96923d0d7f.summary: Global markets and the dollar reacted positively to signals that the Federal Reserve's rate hikes may be nearing an end.
n96923d0d7f.why: Federal Reserve policy impacts global liquidity, interest rates, and currency markets, influencing investment and borrowing costs.
n96923d0d7f.why_moved: Market expectations of Fed rate peaking reduce dollar demand and support equities.

n1f05ec052b.headline: CEA Nageswaran sees RBI holding fire if Fed hikes again
n1f05ec052b.summary: The Reserve Bank of India indicates it is not under pressure to raise interest rates in response to potential US Federal Reserve rate hikes.
n1f05ec052b.why: India's monetary policy influences borrowing costs, inflation, and capital flows in the Indian economy.

ndfa0361b3c.headline: Kinaxis shares rise as software firm boosts EBITDA guidance after strong Q3 report
ndfa0361b3c.summary: Kinaxis stock increased following a positive Q3 report and an outlook for continued sales pipeline growth.
ndfa0361b3c.why: Kinaxis is a software firm providing supply chain management solutions, relevant for tech and enterprise markets.

n69e666a98c.headline: Najib Razak in hospital with COVID
n69e666a98c.summary: Najib Razak, Malaysia's former prime minister, has been admitted to hospital after testing positive for COVID-19.
n69e666a98c.why: Political stability and leadership health can influence market sentiment and government policy outlooks.

n83fccf2947.headline: India’s investment in Nigeria above $27b from 200 companies, says consul
n83fccf2947.summary: India's investment in Nigeria surpasses $27 billion with over 200 companies, making India a major trading partner and importer of Nigerian crude oil.
n83fccf2947.why: Foreign direct investment influences economic growth, trade balances, and geopolitical relations between India and Nigeria.

n7ba27168c8.headline: BT maintains 2024 outlook after Q2 core profit beat
n7ba27168c8.summary: BT Group raised its full-year outlook following a Q2 earnings beat, supporting its shares.
n7ba27168c8.why: BT is a major UK telecom provider; its financial results impact investor confidence and sector outlook.

n26fa522cd2.headline: Uganda: Oil Pipeline Protests Stifled
n26fa522cd2.summary: Environmental and anti-fossil fuel activists in Uganda face arrests and threats over a planned oil pipeline project.
n26fa522cd2.why: The protests highlight social and environmental risks associated with oil infrastructure development in Uganda.

nf0bab6f699.headline: Market share begins to improve for Kraft Heinz
nf0bab6f699.summary: Kraft Heinz's market share begins to recover amid a dip in third-quarter sales in North America.
nf0bab6f699.why: Changes in market share reflect competitive positioning and consumer demand in the food industry.

n3ce3aadc6a.headline: Apple suffers full year of declining revenues for first time since 2019
n3ce3aadc6a.summary: Apple's revenue declined for the first time since 2019, amid macroeconomic uncertainties.
n3ce3aadc6a.why: Apple is a major technology company whose financial performance impacts global markets and supply chains.

n94d8adb81f.headline: Japan PM Unveils $113 Bn Stimulus As Poll Numbers Slump
n94d8adb81f.summary: Japanese Prime Minister Fumio Kishida unveiled a stimulus package worth over $100 billion to ease inflation pressures and support the economy.
n94d8adb81f.why: Large fiscal stimulus aims to boost Japan's economy during inflationary pressures and political challenges.

n062a399011.headline: As October sets a record for UPI transactions, where else in the world can you use it?
n062a399011.summary: Unified Payments Interface (UPI) transactions in India reached a record value of Rs 17.16 trillion in October, a 9% increase from September, with transaction volume also rising to 11.41 billion.
n062a399011.why: UPI is a key digital payments platform in India, and its growth reflects increasing digital financial inclusion and economic activity.

necb769b108.headline: Markets jump in early trade after two days of fall
necb769b108.summary: Indian markets rose about 1% following the US Federal Reserve's pause on interest rate hikes, with Sensex gaining 593 points and Nifty 179 points. Brent crude rose 0.99%, while FIIs offloaded ₹1,816.91 crore.
necb769b108.why: The US Federal Reserve's monetary policy decisions significantly influence global capital flows and investor sentiment, impacting emerging markets like India.

impacts.why: Fed rate pause improves risk sentiment, boosting Indian equity markets.
